fields.summary: Introduce cross-border transfer fee with FX markup
fields.description: Customers sending money overseas must be charged a cross-border fee of 0.5% of the amount plus an FX markup (in basis points). The fee and FX markup must be shown in the fee quote and recorded in the ledger for every cross-border transfer. Regulatory reporting of fees must include the new FX markup component.
acceptance_criteria: Cross-border transfers are charged FEE_RATE_CROSSBORDER plus FX markup
GET /fees/quote returns the fee and FX markup for a destination country
Ledger entries store the FX markup
The daily regulatory extract includes the FX markup
